Sampled uniform on this range so simulated purities span both below and above PROTOCOL.md §3's pre-registered purity floor (0.20) and both its sensitivity values (0.10, 0.30) -- exercising all three operating points a downstream purity-floor check would apply. Not itself a literature-derived range; PROTOCOL.md's own thresholds are this project's design choices, not external literature.

Mean of a Normal draw for simulated tumor sequencing depth. Set to ~2.7x PROTOCOL.md §2 S5's pre-registered 30x tumor-depth floor, giving most simulated samples comfortable headroom above the floor while natural draw variance still occasionally produces sub-floor samples (realistic, not forced).
Mean of a Normal draw for simulated normal sequencing depth. Set to ~2.7x PROTOCOL.md §2 S5's pre-registered 15x normal-depth floor, mirroring the same headroom rationale as TUMOR_DEPTH_MEAN.

Copied verbatim from PROTOCOL.md's own fixed rule (a locus is NOT_EVALUABLE below 20x); not a free simulator choice or an external literature value -- reused here so the simulator's LOH-category injection is genuinely consistent with the protocol it is testing.

Class-conditional P(LOH_SECOND_HIT) for CORE_HR pathogenic-labeled samples. Chosen (with the paired Benign value below) to produce a clean, pre-declared true LR of 7.0 for this quantity -- not fit to reproduce any prior run's output (see the no-v1-reuse check in SIMULATED_data/SIMULATED_no_v1_reuse_check.md).
Paired with the row above; a low baseline reflecting chance/passenger LOH in benign-labeled samples.

Class-conditional P(LOH_SECOND_HIT) for DDR_SIGNALING pathogenic-labeled samples, deliberately weaker separation than CORE_HR's to give the two gene groups distinct injected LR magnitudes (true LR = 2.667) and exercise a different ACMG evidence band (SUPPORTING rather than MODERATE).
Paired with the row above.

Class-conditional Normal for the CORE_HR HRD/GIS-score feature in pathogenic-labeled samples. Mean chosen at/above BENCHMARKS.tsv HRD03's GIS>=42 HRD-positive threshold, evaluated at x=55 to give a true LR of ~75.0 (STRONG band under BENCHMARKS.tsv ODDS01).
Paired with the row above; mean well below the GIS>=42 threshold.

Class-conditional Normal for the DDR_SIGNALING GIS-score feature, deliberately closer to its Benign counterpart than CORE_HR's (weaker true separation), evaluated at x=40 to give a true LR of ~1.75 -- deliberately landing in ACMG NO_EVIDENCE territory (<2.08) despite a non-null true LR, to demonstrate that "not null" and "clears the supporting threshold" are different things.
Paired with the row above.

Class-conditional Normal for the SBS3-like relative-exposure feature (applied across both gene groups -- a whole-tumor mutational-process feature, not gene-specific), evaluated at x=0.35 to give a true LR of ~105.6 (STRONG band).
Paired with the row above.

Engineered-null categorical feature ("HIGH_DEPTH bucket"), deliberately given the IDENTICAL probability in both classes so the true LR is exactly 1.0 by construction -- this is PROTOCOL.md §11's required injected-null quantity.
Paired with the row above; identical to the Pathogenic value by design, not by coincidence.

Conditional split among non-LOH_SECOND_HIT draws across PROTOCOL.md §5.1's remaining categories. None of these four values feeds any injected LR quantity (only the LOH_SECOND_HIT-vs-not split does) -- chosen only to populate PROTOCOL.md's full 5-category space plausibly.
